item.title: Phillies season preview: Alec Bohm will cleanup with free agency on the horizon
item.description: Alec Bohm is in his last year before free agency. Aidan Miller is right there in camp. Change at the hot corner could be right around it.

item.title: The overlooked nutrient your diet may be missing
item.description: Most Americans don’t get enough fiber, even though it’s essential for digestive health and disease prevention. Found in plant foods, fiber is a carbohydrate your body can’t digest but still relies on for key functions.

item.title: Phillies injury updates: The latest on Zack Wheeler, Brandon Marsh, Aidan Miller
item.description: The Phillies are about as healthy as a team can be heading into a new season, carrying what is likely to be 12 players over the age of 30 to their expected 26-man roster.

item.title: James Beard Foundation calls Oyster House one of Philly's 'most rewarding places to eat'
item.description: Oyster House in Center City is among six restaurants to receive a 2026 America's Classic award from the James Beard Foundation.

item.title: Free Library picks 'Our Missing Hearts' for this year's One Book, One Philadelphia reading program
item.description: The Free Library has chosen 'Our Missing Hearts' by Celeste Ng for this year's One Book, One Philadelphia reading program. The novel is set in an American dystopia where books are banned and purged.

item.title: Voters to weigh in on longstanding rule requiring Philly elected officials to resign before running for a new office
item.description: Philadelphia elected officials could be allowed to keep their jobs if they decide to run for state or federal office under legislation that was approved by City Council on Thursday. The measure will now appear as a ballot question in May.

item.title: SEPTA to use AI-powered cameras to ticket cars that block trolley lanes
item.description: SEPTA and the PPA will activate AI-powered cameras to automatically ticket illegally parked cars that block trolley routes Monday. Fines will be issued starting April 1. The system is already used on 152 city buses.

item.title: Hundreds pack Philly school district's headquarters to oppose plan to close schools around city
item.description: Representatives with the School District of Philadelphia presented its facilities master plan to the city’s Board of Education on Thursday, recommending 18 school closures instead of the initial 20.

item.title: Sixers guard Tyrese Maxey breaks Allen Iverson's franchise record for made three-pointers
item.description: Tyrese Maxey only needed 375 NBA games to become the Sixers' all-time franchise leader in triples. He officially passed Allen Iverson on Thursday night at Xfinity Mobile Arena.

item.title: Instant observations: Tyrese Maxey becomes Sixers' all-time three-point shooting leader in critical win over Miami
item.description: In the standings and in the record books, Thursday night's game between the Sixers and Miami Heat meant a lot.
